name: Lighter Hair
author: modChad
description: Every pony's mane and tail with far fewer triangles, for better framerates on Quest 3: the Mane 6 cut to about a quarter (Pinkie 106k to 21k), Anon's pony hair to a third, any background pony hair part over 6k halved, and Applejack's hat halved (2,668 to 1,088). Same look, rig, colours and tail physics.
